description: Refused a share, a coffer, and a part before Abel has copied it.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept Tuesday's reading at his father's house, and kept Sunday's supper clear of a roll.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked for a roll, was refused, and took Tuesday as the day.
name: Will Kemp

description: Set the days he is in and the days he is not, and kept the parts back.
name: William Shakespeare
